SELECT * FROM admission
AND admission_batch = #{batch}
AND university_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{universityName}, '%')
ORDER BY admission_time DESC
SELECT 考号 AS examNumber, 姓名 AS name, 性别 AS gender, 班级 AS className, 录取院校 AS universityName, 高考成绩 AS gaokaoScore, 录取批次 AS admissionBatch FROM view_batch_admission_students ORDER BY 录取批次, 考号
